title: the Sundered Sea Rising Again
author: Rosalind Whitlock
blurb: Xanthe Okonkwo, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
